title: ExecutionPermit
description: Final admitted action digest, enforcement grade, adapter, constraints, expiry and single-use nonce (plan: 'Wire contracts'). Schema only — E0 defines this shape; issuing one (deciding admission) is E2 scope. The plan's single-use nonce IS the envelope's nonce field; there is no second nonce. Platform names never enter this schema (plan: 'Host adapters') — adapter is a free identifier of an adapter class (e.g. 'subprocess'), not a product name.

enforcement_grade.description: plan: only mediated/platform are enforcement; advisory may be ignored by the caller

constraints.description: lane/lock/drift bindings and any other admission-time constraint; free-form, host- and adapter-defined
